name: 2D Feature Grids for SDF
definition: A method to factorize a 3D feature grid into three 2D feature grids to reduce rendering times and memory, assuming independence between feature distributions in orthogonal planes.
summary: 2D Feature Grids for SDF is a memory-efficient neural scene representation that factorizes a 3D SDF into three coordinate-aligned 2D grids, differing from K-planes by using fixed planes and from Forplane by explicitly modeling SDF values.
